Description

COSTA VERDE COTTAGE
Rosemary Beach Community
East Long Green Road, Rosemary Beach, FL 32461

Home Highlights

  • 4 bedrooms (see “Room Details” for configurations)
  • 4 full baths, 1 half bath
  • Sleeps 10 guests
  • 2,250 sq. ft.
  • Private pool (can be heated upon request for an additional fee)
  • Downstairs wet bar, wine fridge, and full bath with shower for poolside convenience
  • Open galley kitchen with wrap-around quartz counters, farm sink, Viking range, and microwave
  • 2-car driveway + 1 vehicle overflow (1 community parking pass issued per home)
  • Four 26" adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb not included; additional rentals available)

Welcome to Costa Verde Cottage
This beautifully styled 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath home offers luxury and comfort in the heart of Rosemary Beach. With space for up to 10 guests and one of the largest private pools in the area, Costa Verde Cottage provides the perfect blend of location, style, and convenience.

Location & Lifestyle
Situated on East Long Green Road, you’re just steps from the beach, Rosemary Town Center, boutique shops, and restaurants. Overlooking East Long Green Park, the home is perfect for enjoying local events, summer farmers’ markets, or evening strolls.

Sleeps, Layout & Bedrooms

  • Master king suite with jetted tub and pool views
  • King guest suite with private bath
  • Bunk room with 4 twin beds (ideal for kids or teens)
  • Queen guest bedroom

Indoor & Outdoor Entertaining

  • Private pool and patio with seating and dining options (pool heating available upon request)
  • Downstairs wet bar + wine fridge and full bath for easy pool access
  • Upstairs covered balcony overlooking Long Green Park
  • Gourmet open galley kitchen with wrap-around quartz counters, farm sink, Viking gas range, and microwave

Additional Amenities

  • Full-size laundry room
  • Four adult bikes included seasonally
  • Outdoor gas fire pit for cool evenings
  • Ample parking: 2-vehicle driveway + overflow

Why Guests Love Costa Verde Cottage
Costa Verde Cottage combines private pool luxury, walkability, and spacious design for the ultimate 30A vacation. Enjoy beach days, local dining, biking adventures, or relaxing at home — all in one place. - Nearby Property Recommendation: If you’re traveling with a group, check out Pipers Nest, just steps away.

Community Amenities

  • Four community pools (some heated seasonally)
  • Private beach access
  • Rosemary Town Square with shopping and dining
  • Playground, parks, and green spaces
  • Outdoor amphitheater
  • Pedestrian paths and lush landscaping
  • Fitness center and racquet club (additional fee)

Note: Golf carts are prohibited in Rosemary Beach

Pool Heating
Available Oct–Apr for an additional cost; only operational when outdoor temperatures are between 50°F–80°F.

Parking

  • Designated 2-car driveway; 1 community parking pass per HOA
  • On-street parking first-come, first-served with proper permit
  • 30A Cottages not liable for fines or towing

Reservation & Booking Policy

  • 50% due at booking; balance due 60 days prior
  • Optional travel insurance available
  • Cancellation: Initial 50% refundable if canceled >60 days before arrival (5% processing fee applies)
  • No smoking, no pets (service animals with documentation permitted)
  • Check-in: 4 PM CST | Check-out: 10 AM CST
  • Guests must be 25+

Amenities

  • No Pets Allowed
  • Private Pool
  • Outdoor Gas Grill
  • Flat Screen Televisions
  • Free Wireless Internet
  • Linens Provided
  • Washer/ Dryer

Costa Verde - Perfect

Reviewed on 07-20-2023 by Reese
5
Costa Verde is an excellent well maintained home in a perfect location in Rosemary Beach. The house is very well made and designed. The 4 bedrooms downstairs works great and the stairwell separates the master from the other bedrooms so there is excellent privacy and quiet in the master suite. There is a second suite plus 2 more bedrooms and bathrooms downstairs. Upstairs is elegant and comfortable. The house was perfect for hanging out inside and outside on the balcony or at the pool. The living areas and well stocked kitchen are perfect for dinner at "home" or game night in. The pool lights up with colored lights at night which makes an elegant ambiance. The Weber grill is large and awesome like Weber always is. The house is luxurious and comfortable for your stay in Rosemary. And in a great location to enjoy downtown shopping and restaurants and a short walk to the beach. And last but certainly not least- 30A Cottages does an incredible job managing the property. From check in to check out - they managed the process as well as anyplace I have stayed around the world. They were quickly responsive to texts and phone calls. They repaired the oven door quickly even when it wasn’t urgent and communicated with me through this seamlessly. All and all - a perfect stay at Costa Verde and working with 30A Cottages.
